arxiv-2008-04172.title: A single-cell mathematical model of SARS-CoV-2 induced pyroptosis and the effects of anti-inflammatory intervention
arxiv-2008-04172.creator: Sara J Hamis,
arxiv-2008-04172.description: Abstract Pyroptosis is an inflammatory mode of cell death that can contribute to the cytokine storm associated with severe cases of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19). The formation of the NLRP3 inflammasome is central to pyroptosis, which may be induced by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2). Inflammasome formation, and by extension pyroptosis, may be inhibited by certain anti-inflammatory drugs.

arxiv-2103-11460.title: UAV Images Dataset for Moving Object Detection from Moving Cameras
arxiv-2103-11460.creator: İbrahim Delibaşoğlu
arxiv-2103-11460.description: Abstract This paper presents a new high resolution aerial images dataset in which moving objects are labelled manually. It aims to contribute to the evaluation of the moving object detection methods for moving cameras. The problem of recognizing moving objects from aerial images is one of the important issues in computer vision.

arxiv-2107-13790.title: Non-Markovian Reinforcement Learning using Fractional Dynamics
arxiv-2107-13790.creator: Gaurav Gupta, Chenzhong Yin, Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh, Paul Bogdan
arxiv-2107-13790.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) is a technique to learn the control policy for an agent that interacts with a stochastic environment. In any given state, the agent takes some action, and the environment determines the probability distribution over the next state as well as gives the agent some reward.

arxiv-2112-08507.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Tong Li, Jacob Nogas, Haochen Song, Harsh Kumar, Audrey Durand, Anna Rafferty, Nina Deliu, Sofia S. Villar, Joseph J. Williams. Multi-armed bandit algorithms like Thompson Sampling (TS) can be used to conduct adaptive experiments, in which maximizing reward means that data is used to progressively assign participants to more effective arms.

arxiv-2206-02123.title: On the volume of the Minkowski sum of zonoids
arxiv-2206-02123.creator: Matthieu Fradelizi, Mokshay Madiman, Mathieu Meyer, Artem Zvavitch
arxiv-2206-02123.description: Abstract We explore some inequalities in convex geometry restricted to the class of zonoids. We show the equivalence, in the class of zonoids, between a local Alexandrov-Fenchel inequality, a local Loomis-Whitney inequality, the log-submodularity of volume, and the Dembo-Cover-Thomas conjecture on the monotonicity of the ratio of volume to the surface area.

arxiv-2408-06497.title: Inefficiencies of Carbon Trading Markets Nicola Borri, LUISS University, email: nborri@luiss.it. Yukun Liu, University of Rochester, email: yliu229@ur.rochester.edu. Aleh Tsyvinski, Corresponding author, Department of Economics at Yale University, email: a.tsyvinski@yale.edu. Xi Wu, University of Ca
arxiv-2408-06497.creator: Nicola Borri, Yukun Liu, Aleh Tsyvinski, Xi Wu
arxiv-2408-06497.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nicola Borri, Yukun Liu, Aleh Tsyvinski, Xi Wu. The European Union Emission Trading System is a prominent market-based mechanism to reduce emissions. While the theory is well-understood, we are the first to study the whole cap-and-trade mechanism as a financial market. Analyzing the universe of transactions in 2005-2020 (more than one million records of granular transaction data), we show that this market features significant inefficiencies undermining its goals. First, about 40% of firms never trade in a given year.

arxiv-2409-18846.title: Lattice QCD calculation of the η \eta and η ′ \eta^{\prime} meson masses at the physical point using rooted staggered fermions
arxiv-2409-18846.creator: Willem E. A. Verplanke, Zoltan Fodor, Antoine Gérardin, Jana N. Guenther, Laurent Lellouch, Kalman K. Szabo, Balint C. Toth, Lukas Varnhorst
arxiv-2409-18846.description: Abstract We present a lattice calculation of the η \eta and η ′ \eta^{\prime} meson masses at the physical point and in the continuum limit, based on N f = 2 + 1 + 1 N_{f}=2+1+1 flavors of rooted staggered quarks.

arxiv-2512-02992.description: Abstract We present details regarding the construction of a composite spectrum of quasar (QSO) absorption line systems. In this composite spectrum we identify more than 70 absorption lines, and observe oxygen and hydrogen emission features at a higher signal-to-noise ratio than in any previous study.

pmc-10535690.title: Probiotic Characteristics of Streptococcus thermophilus and Lactobacillus bulgaricus as Influenced by New Food Sources
pmc-10535690.creator: Ashly Castro, Ricardo S Aleman, Miguel Tabora, Shirin Kazemzadeh, Leyla K Pournaki, Roberto Cedillos, Jhunior Marcia, Kayanush Aryana, Jesús Lozano-Sánchez, Ascensión Rueda, Cristiano Menezes

pmc-11397118.title: Genome-Wide Identification of GH17s Family Genes and Biological Function Analysis of SlA6 in Tomato
pmc-11397118.creator: Da Chen, Zaohai Zeng, Canye Yu, Huimin Hu, Yuxiang Lin, Caiyu Wu, Yinghua Yang, Qiuxiang Zhong, Xinyue Zhang, Caihong Huang, Yiwen Yao, Zhengkun Qiu, Xiaomin Wang, Rui Xia, Chongjian Ma, Riyuan Chen, Yanwei Hao, Hongling Guan, Andreas W Ebert
pmc-11397118.description: Glycoside hydrolases (GHs), enzymes that break down glycosidic bonds in carbohydrates and between carbohydrates and non-carbohydrates, are prevalent in plants, animals, microorganisms, and other organisms. The tomato is a significant crop that contains the GH17 gene family. However, its role in tomatoes has yet to be fully investigated.

pmc-11489079.title: Long noncoding RNA EPCART regulates translation through PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway and PDCD4 in prostate cancer
pmc-11489079.creator: Annika Kohvakka, Mina Sattari, Janika Nättinen, Ulla Aapola, Pavlína Gregorová, Teuvo L J Tammela, Hannu Uusitalo, L Peter Sarin, Tapio Visakorpi, Leena Latonen
pmc-11489079.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). While hundreds of cancer-associated long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) have been discovered, their functional role in cancer cells is still largely a mystery. An increasing number of lncRNAs are recognized to function in the cytoplasm, e.g., as modulators of translation. Here, we investigated the detailed molecular identity and functional role of EPCART, a lncRNA we previously discovered to be a potential oncogene in prostate cancer (PCa).

pmc-12404466.title: An open-source replication for fast and accessible light propagation modeling in brain tissue
pmc-12404466.creator: David Berling, Jan Střeleček, Tomáš Iser, Ján Antolík
pmc-12404466.description: Light simulations hold great potential for advancing optical techniques in neuroscience. They facilitate the in-silico refinement of optical stimulator designs and enable simulations of optical recordings from computational brain models, aiding neuroscience in forming a mechanistic understanding of brain circuitry.

pmc-12472526.title: Isolation, Molecular Characterization and In Vitro Propagation of an Anaplasma platys-Like Bacterium in Tick Cells
pmc-12472526.creator: Erica Rodrigues de Matos, Priscilla Nunes dos Santos, Erich Peter Zweygarth, Talys Henrique Assumpção Jardim, Huarrisson Azevedo Santos, Matheus Dias Cordeiro, Bruna de Azevedo Baêta, Lesley Bell-Sakyi, Adivaldo Henrique da Fonseca, Claudia Bezerra da Silva
pmc-12472526.description: The family Anaplasmataceae comprises etiological agents of infectious diseases of significant importance. This study aimed to achieve the in vitro isolation and propagation of an Anaplasma sp. using tick-derived cell lines. The study was realized in Seropédica municipality, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Blood smears from a naturally infected bovine revealed cytoplasmic inclusions in blood cells.

pmc-12622222.title: Directed vascularization in bone regeneration requires bone marrow reconstitution
pmc-12622222.creator: Julia Mehl, Tobias Thiele, Agnes Ellinghaus, Holger Gerhardt, Georg N Duda
pmc-12622222.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Bone has the unique ability to regenerate without scarring, yet the cellular dynamics and directional organization underlying this process, and how they are linked to marrow reconstitution, remain incompletely understood. To investigate these mechanisms, we developed a novel double osteotomy model in mice, involving transplantation of a 2-mm bone graft between genetically distinct fluorescent reporter lines (yellow fluorescent protein and red fluorescent protein). This approach enabled precise tracking of cellular migration and vascularization over 3, 7, and 14 d post-transplantation.

pmc-12679257.title: Upgrading the therapeutic potential of catechin against Ehrlich carcinoma and mitigating oxidative stress in the liver employing chitosan polyaspartate as nanodelivery vehicles
pmc-12679257.creator: Mohammad Y. Alfaifi, Mustafa R. Abdulbaqi, Wesam Abd El-Fattah, Ali A. Shati, Serag Eldin I. Elbehairi, Reda F. M. Elshaarawy, Waleed M. Serag, Yasser A. Hassan
pmc-12679257.description: This study aims to design and develop new chitosan polyaspartate nanovehicles (CPANVs) to enhance the targeting delivery and bioavailability of catechin (CAT). Thus, augmenting its anticancer efficacy against Ehrlich ascites carcinoma (EAC) in the peritoneal cavities of Swiss albino mice and without impairing the liver or its functions.

pmc-13187887.title: AI for cervical cancer screening on whole slide images: opportunities with open-source simple tools
pmc-13187887.creator: Laura Nonnis, Lorenzo Putzu, Michela Vincis, Stefano Guerriero, Marco Palomba, Alessio Rocca, Daniela Fanni, Clara Gerosa, Marcello Trucas
pmc-13187887.description: SummaryObjectiveCervical cancer remains a major global health burden, where early detection is critical. Cytological and histological assessments aim to identify precancerous squamous intraepithelial lesions (SILs). While artificial intelligence and machine learning have shown promise, most approaches rely on cytology or are not tailored for SIL classification.

pmc-13241336.title: Patient-reported outcomes and health-related quality of life in individuals living with, through, and beyond cancer in Sweden: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13241336.creator: Sixten Borg, Linn Rosell, Lars Garpenhag, Susanna Calling, Anna-Maria Larsson
pmc-13241336.description: BackgroundThe use of patient-reported outcome measures (PROM) can be beneficial in several ways. However, presentations of PROM data from individuals living with, through, or beyond cancer are scarce in the existing scientific literature, and challenges in presenting and interpreting PROM data may be an explanation.
